consentText: Our verification partner will check your ID document, take a short selfie to confirm it is you, and screen your name against watchlists and lists of politically exposed people. Grade10 keeps a copy of the document and the result, and can use it wherever you need to be verified with us. You can ask us to delete it at any time.
consentLabel: I agree to my ID document and my face being checked, to my name being screened against watchlists and lists of politically exposed people, and to Grade10 keeping the result.
